title: DIY haptic input knob: BLDC motor + round LCD
summary: A two-minute demo of SmartKnob View, an open-source input knob built from a brushless gimbal motor, magnetic encoder and round LCD. Closed-loop torque control gives software-defined detents and end stops.
why: HN people hold it up as a polished solo hardware project and the go-to example of haptic knobs, including in discussions of physical car controls.

quote.text: I made a rotary input device that provides software-defined "virtual" detents and end-stops, implemented using a BLDC gimbal motor.
